title: Change learned line indicator from background to border
description: Currently learned lines have a green background tint which changes the look of the line. Instead, use a green left border (or end border for RTL) to indicate learned status. The background should remain unchanged from unlearned lines.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Remove green background from learned lines
Add green left/start border to learned lines instead
Learned lines have same background as unlearned lines
Border is clearly visible but not distracting
